nodes.text: You. Den-breaker. Word climbs faster than people. Bears on the near shoulders. Trolls behind. Two and two, before the snow.

choices.text: Two bears, two trolls. On it.
Who's asking, you or the city?

nodes.text: Roofs don't ask. Roofs see. What I see is a shepherd's kid on the high pasture and a bear that's stopped being shy, so...
High ground around the city. Watch the scree line when the light goes flat, that's when they... You'll see.
Hm. The snow won't wait on either of us.
